title: Show HN: GlycemicGPT – Open-source AI-powered diabetes management
summary: GlycemicGPT is an open-source, self-hosted platform built by a Type 1 diabetic engineer that connects continuous glucose monitors (Dexcom G7), insulin pumps (Tandem t:slim X2/Mobi), and Nightscout instances to an AI analysis layer running entirely on the user's own infrastructure.
problem_solved: Enables continuous diabetes data analysis and management when professional medical oversight is unavailable between clinical appointments.
why_valuable: Provides a private, self-hosted AI-powered diabetes management system that works with multiple medical devices, reducing dependence on commercial platforms and clinicians.
